selection_reason: The definition identifies the braid group with the fundamental group of the unordered configuration space at an explicit base orbit; a strand-motion picture could relate loops to geometric braids.
reviewer_reason: The definition is deliberately an abstract fundamental-group definition and explicitly postpones identification with geometric strand diagrams. It specifies no example loop, crossings, or endpoint permutation. A loop/lift picture is better attached to the later monodromy or geometric-identification construction.
